title: Grab And Move may crop the captured bounding box

judgment.rationale: The issue contains before/after images but no text describing the actual crop discrepancy, no interaction sequence, and no display scaling or capture context. Multiple coordinate paths are plausible, so a source fix would be speculative.
evidence: The report identifies PowerToys 0.101.2432 preview and Windows 11 Insider build 29639.1000.
The Steps to reproduce and Expected Behavior fields contain images, while Actual Behavior is empty.
The only discussion comment requests concrete reproduction steps and the Needs-Author-Feedback label remains present.
Grab And Move uses GetWindowRect and DwmGetWindowAttribute extended-frame bounds for its overlay geometry, but the supplied report does not identify which geometry is wrong.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a precise Grab And Move interaction sequence and annotated actual-versus-expected result before selecting a coordinate or crop path.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code change is not yet defensible because the report does not identify a reproducible failing path or the geometry that differs.

issue_context.summary: Screenshots suggest a Grab And Move bounding-box or visible-frame discrepancy on an Insider build, but the operation and the incorrect region are not described.

issue_context.analysis: The module computes overlay geometry from both window and DWM extended-frame rectangles, but the report does not state whether the capture refers to the overlay, move target, resize target, or a visual comparison. Asking for the minimum sequence and annotated discrepancy is more useful than a generic log request and avoids guessing a coordinate conversion fix.
initial_investigation: Reviewed src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp: the drag/resize overlay derives visible margins from GetWindowRect and DWMWA_EXTENDED_FRAME_BOUNDS.
Reviewed the full issue body and its sole automated-triage comment; no human reproduction steps, duplicate, linked fix, or assignee is present.
Checked current upstream references and fork traces; no related open fix or fork mirror was found.

actions.label: Request Grab And Move reproduction details

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots and the Insider-build details. To identify whether this is a move, resize, overlay, DPI, or frame-boundary problem, please provide the numbered sequence from enabling Grab And Move through the result: include Alt or Win mode, left or right mouse button, target window, and what you mean by capture/bounding box. Please also annotate the expected and actual rectangles (or attach a short recording) and state the scaling percentage and monitor arrangement used.
